headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI-Powered Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate machine learning models to predict and mitigate risks associated with npm/PyPI packages, including binding.gyp command expansion. Utilize natural language processing for improved documentation parsing and user-friendly alerts.
actions: Implement an AI model that analyzes package metadata, dependencies, and historical usage data to flag potential risks before installation.
Develop a feature that uses NLP to parse and understand package documentation more accurately, providing clearer explanations of the risks involved.
Create a real-time risk assessment dashboard that visualizes potential issues and suggests safer alternatives or mitigation strategies.
